title: Apply the change and verify your earlier work
goal: Apply one new attribute to your copy, save a note in an earlier customer and reconcile existing requests and report.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 3; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: A saved description must be applied
paragraphs: The previous lesson saved the editable configuration. Enterprise uses database configuration, so Ctrl+S alone does not prove the field is available. F7 updates the database structure to match development. Use only the prepared copy after closing its Enterprise session.

Expect a change to Справочник.Клиенты adding УчебнаяЗаметка. The observed Реорганизация информации dialog shows one changed catalog. That does not imply another catalog or loss of old items. Cancel and investigate unexpected deletions, unrelated objects or unexplained requirements.

sections.title: One change, two sides of verification
paragraphs: Verification should detect both missing functionality and damaged prior data.

code.source:
Added: Клиенты.УчебнаяЗаметка, String 80.
New: a note writes and rereads at the same code.
Old: request numbers and 4/120 retained.
code.output: The new capability works alongside previous behavior.

sections.title: Test the same earlier item
paragraphs: After successful updating, open this copy in Enterprise and choose Клиенты. Its automatic form/list exposes Учебная заметка. Open the earlier Учебный Север by your recorded code. Name and code should remain unchanged, and the new field initially empty.

Enter Учебная заметка сохранена в новой копии., choose Записать и закрыть and reopen the same code. A reread value is stronger evidence than clicking Write. Creating a new customer instead does not test preservation of the earlier identity.

sections.title: Check neighboring capabilities too
paragraphs: Reopen old request numbers and compare customer, service, minutes, status and comments. Adding a customer note should not change them. Generate the unrestricted report: the sequential dataset remains four/120, first customer three/105 and second one/15. Reconcile your own expectation for additional work.

Counts and sums do not replace identities and field comparison. Different sets can produce equal totals. The actual illustration shows the total after changing metadata; your control table additionally checks concrete numbers. Stronger engineering acceptance compares references and every agreed field independently of the report.

sections.title: Deleting a field is not a safe return
paragraphs: Reversing structure does not automatically restore data.

code.source: After entering notes, someone deletes the field to make it as before.
code.output: Entered values may be lost; preserve state and choose a verified return point.

sections.title: Rollback returns a state, not just a caption
paragraphs: If the field is absent, first verify the infobase, successful F7 and a freshly opened Enterprise window. A custom form in another configuration might require separate field presentation; this does not justify loading an arbitrary .cf over development. This package’s form is automatic and observed on the stated platform version.

For a serious discrepancy the original remains a separate return point. Restore a .dt into another new empty infobase and reconcile against its export date. Later records do not appear in that older backup automatically. Do not delete the attribute merely to roll back: entered notes can be lost. Preserve the failed attempt, explain the cause, then choose a repair.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: The configuration is saved but Enterprise still uses the earlier structure. Apply F7 to the correct copy, wait and open a fresh client.
A new customer is created instead of testing earlier work. Use the previous actual code and compare that same item.
An attribute with entered notes is deleted to roll back. Preserve state and use a verified separate original or restore a .dt into a new base.

selfcheck.prompt: What applies the structure to the database?
Plan additional boundary input and rollback, stating the .dt data date.
selfcheck.feedback: No promise of later records in an older backup or attribute deletion as cosmetic rollback.

steps.title: Review the intended change
steps.action: Verify the copy and attribute properties, close its Enterprise session and save the configuration.
steps.why: Apply only the agreed change with a return point.
steps.expected: One string attribute is expected in existing Клиенты.
steps.troubleshooting: Prepare a .dt and verified original through lesson one before updating if missing.
steps.before: One УчебнаяЗаметка String 80 attribute is saved in copy Designer; original and .dt remain separate.

steps.title: Read the reorganization
steps.action: Press F7 and inspect Реорганизация информации: expect changed Справочник.Клиенты. Accept only the expected change and wait for completion.
steps.why: Separate development saving from database application.
steps.expected: The dialog closes without error and database configuration is updated.
steps.troubleshooting: Cancel unexpected deletions or unrelated changes and preserve the observation.
steps.before: One string attribute is expected in existing Клиенты.

steps.title: Open the earlier customer
steps.action: Open Учебный Север — ремонт by its earlier actual code; compare code/name and locate the empty note.
steps.why: Test an existing object after a model change.
steps.expected: Previous code/name intact; the optional field is available and empty.
steps.troubleshooting: Verify base and successful F7 instead of creating a new item.
steps.before: The dialog closes without error and database configuration is updated.

figures.caption: After updating, both existing customers remain with an initially empty new column and retained codes.

steps.title: Write and reread
steps.action: Enter Учебная заметка сохранена в новой копии., choose Записать и закрыть and reopen the same code.
steps.expected: The same item contains the text with code/name unchanged.
steps.troubleshooting: If absent, preserve other unsaved work and verify write completion, code and infobase.
steps.before: Previous code/name intact; the optional field is available and empty.

figures.caption: After writing and reopening, the same 000000001 code retains the text. Use your own item’s actual code.
figures.alt: After writing and reopening, the same 000000001 code retains the text. Use your own item’s actual code.

steps.title: Reconcile earlier requests
steps.where: Заявка услуги and Отчёты → Заявки по клиентам
steps.action: Open recorded numbers and compare fields. Generate the report with Клиент disabled and compare independently.
steps.why: A new capability must preserve earlier work.
steps.troubleshooting: Equal sums do not replace identity comparison; do not edit durations to hide discrepancies.
steps.before: The same item contains the text with code/name unchanged.

figures.caption: After adding the attribute the report retains four requests and 120 minutes. A separate native comparison also verifies earlier identities and fields.
figures.alt: After adding the attribute the report retains four requests and 120 minutes. A separate native comparison also verifies earlier identities and fields.

steps.title: Record the evidence boundary
steps.action: Record platform version, copy, field, earlier code, reread text and previous-scenario outcomes. Retain original, .dt and failed attempts separately.
steps.why: Make the change and its limits reproducible.
steps.expected: An observable result exists; Nexus completion remains self-report.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not claim all versions or input boundaries from this single ordinary text test.

criteria: Development, database structure and record values separated.
New value persists and prior data agrees.
No promise of later records in an older backup or attribute deletion as cosmetic rollback.
Expected change, version, earlier code and actual reread text.
Number/field and report comparisons with explicit completed/pending boundaries.
Unexpected deletion in the update causes cancellation and investigation, not automatic acceptance.
